description:
The Rally Balance Bike is the perfect first phase to teach a child to ride a bike! This training no pedal push bicycle from Vilano Bikes prepares children to balance, steer and get comfortable on a bicycle.

Not just a toy, the Rally Balance Bike is a fun and educational tool designed with a child in mind. The vibrant, bright colors and cute details of this push bike will have a child eager to get in the saddle, and get out (more importantly!) and learn to ride a bicycle.

Learning to ride a bike should be fun for children, and the Rally Balance Bike is a great way to start them off on the right foot! On a pushbike, kids learn steering, balancing and other precious motor skills they’ll need as they develop. Boys and girls will love the bright colors and be eager to hop on and ride this balance bike.

The Vilano Rally Balance Bike is adjustable and will grow with your child. The Customer Service team can help with any questions you have about everything from the simple assembly of the Rally Balance Bike to teaching a child to ride a bike. Check out this balance bike if you want to make learning to ride simple, enjoyable and fast for any child.

components.description: The padded for safety handlebars are adjustable from 20″ to 21.5″ for the best possible fit.
Durable never flat foam tires come on the molded plastic wheels.
The seat height of this learning pushbike is also adjustable from 15.5″ to 17.5″ and grows with the child.
Easy to transport, the Rally Balance Bike has a durable steel frame, yet weighs only 7.25 lbs.
